entries.text: Someone listening with a screen reader reaches the footer and hears three links in a row announced as just "link" with the raw URL or nothing useful — no "Facebook", no "YouTube". The same three empty links sit in the tab order on every page of the flow, so a keyboard listener tabbing out of the form hits three unlabelled stops they must either activate blindly or skip past, five times over.

Someone with low vision reading the pale grey "Last updated October 3, 2026" line sees it nearly dissolve into the white background at normal brightness, and on the upload screen the same grey hides "Max 10 MB per file. Up to 5 files." They lose the one hint that would stop a failed upload, and the date they need to judge whether their status is current, on every page.

On the status page, someone listening with a screen reader lands on the refresh control and hears only "button" — nothing about what pressing it does, so checking whether their claim has moved becomes guesswork. In the upload dialog the close control is equally silent, leaving a listener trapped in a panel with no announced way out.
